description: This source file defines a Flutter widget 'LudoBoardWidget' that visually renders a simplified, stylized Ludo game board with interactive game pieces. It includes custom painting for the board, piece positioning logic, and interaction handling, indicating it's a key visual component in a Ludo mobile app.

classes.name: LudoBoardWidget
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders the Ludo game board with game pieces, highlights, and interaction capabilities.

classes.name: _BoardPainter
classes.description: CustomPainter responsible for drawing the static components of the Ludo board, such as yards, tracks, and central areas.

classes.name: _UiColors
classes.description: A utility class providing color mappings for Ludo colors.

classes.name: _BoardCoordinates
classes.description: A utility class for calculating on-screen positions of game pieces based on their logical positions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree, including layout, piece positioning, and gesture detection.

methods.name: _drawYard
methods.description: Draws the colored yard quadrants on the board.

methods.name: _drawHomeArrow
methods.description: Draws guiding arrows from the track towards the center to indicate home stretches.

methods.name: pieceCenterFor
methods.description: Calculates the visual center point for a game piece based on its logical position.
